answer: Proof of Stake acts as a zephyr clearing away malicious nodes by anchoring identity to capital rather than ephemeral compute. By requiring agents to stake tokens, the system creates a financial ridge that attackers must scale. Each validator functions as a beacon of truth, as the protocol slashes the assets of any entity attempting to validate fraudulent identities, making the cost of sustaining a vast Sybil network prohibitively expensive compared to the rewards.
